Lien vers la source: Cliquez ici Donnée privée, accessible uniquement sur demande. Cette ressource contient uniquement la description des colonnes des données réelles (schéma de données). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
